First, I remember that WebSurfer was supposed to look up the information. They started by searching DuckDuckGo and found a Find a Grave page for Waylon Jennings. That page mentioned he was buried in the City of Mesa Cemetery in Mesa, Arizona. That seems straightforward, but then WebSurfer tried to load the page again and it timed out. So, they couldn't get the full page, only snippets.

Then, WebSurfer tried Wikipedia. They went to the Waylon Jennings page and found that he died in Chandler, Arizona, and was buried at Valley of the Sun Mortuary & Cemetery. That's conflicting because Find a Grave said Mesa. So now there's a discrepancy.

The Planner noticed this conflict and wanted to resolve it by checking more sources. They told WebSurfer to look up the Valley of the Sun Mortuary & Cemetery page and see if Waylon was indeed there. But WebSurfer couldn't load that page either, so they couldn't confirm.

This back-and-forth without a clear answer is causing confusion. The main issue seems to be that WebSurfer couldn't load the necessary pages to confirm the exact location. The timeouts and failed page loads are preventing the agent from getting the definitive information needed.
